title: Open Arbor Regenerative Consulting Arborist (RCA-Spec v2.0) Assessment Schema
description: AGPL v3 JSON Schema for the Assessments.data_json column when assessment_type is 'Regenerative Diagnostic' (supporting RCA_v1 and RCA_v2). Enforces typed, unit-explicit field capture across the five mandatory diagnostic domains of Regenerative Consulting Arboriculture, absorbing Shigo CODIT, Mattheck t/R shell mechanics, and Holobiont Living Asset Equity.

schema_version.description: Identifier for the Regenerative Consulting Arborist Practice Specification version (unit: version string).

assessment_mode.description: Required discriminator matching Assessments.assessment_type in 09_FEATURE_BRIEF_ASSESSMENT_FORMS.md (unit: enum string).

structural_baseline.description: Domain 1: Above-ground biometric inventory, ISA TRAQ risk matrix fields, and municipal tree protection ordinance disposition.

dbh_cm.description: Final calculated Diameter at Breast Height measured at 1.37 m above grade (unit: centimeters).

is_multistem.description: True if the tree forks below 1.37 m into multiple measurable stems (unit: boolean).

stem_diameters_cm.description: Individual stem diameters measured at 1.37 m when is_multistem is true (unit: centimeters).

multistem_aggregation_method.description: Formula used to aggregate stem_diameters_cm into dbh_cm per src/core/rootZone.js (unit: enum string).

height_m.description: Total vertical tree height from root flare grade to highest live crown tip (unit: meters).

crown_spread_ns_m.description: Canopy dripline diameter along the North-South axis (unit: meters).

crown_spread_ew_m.description: Canopy dripline diameter along the East-West axis (unit: meters).

live_crown_ratio_pct.description: Ratio of live photosynthetic crown height to total tree height (unit: percent).

plus_code_global.description: Open Location Code (Plus Code) pinpointing stem coordinates (unit: 10-to-15 character Plus Code string).

tree_tag.description: Optional field tag or inventory identifier for the assessed tree (unit: tag string).

species_scientific.description: Optional botanical binomial of the assessed host tree (unit: Latin binomial string).

species_common.description: Optional regional common name of the assessed host tree (unit: string).

inaturalist_taxon_id.description: Optional iNaturalist taxon ID of the assessed host tree (unit: integer ID).

assessment_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date of the field diagnostic assessment (unit: YYYY-MM-DD date).

isa_traq_risk.description: International Society of Arboriculture Tree Risk Assessment Qualification (TRAQ) Level 2/3 risk matrix fields.

assessment_level.description: ANSI A300 Part 9 / ISA TRAQ inspection level (unit: enum string).

time_frame_years.description: Specified period over which likelihood of failure is evaluated (unit: years).

target_zone_description.description: People, property, or infrastructure within striking distance and occupancy rate (unit: narrative string).

primary_tree_part_of_concern.description: Structural component governing the highest risk rating (unit: enum string).

likelihood_of_failure.description: ISA TRAQ Matrix 1 row: probability of structural failure within time_frame_years (unit: TRAQ enum).

likelihood_of_impact.description: ISA TRAQ Matrix 1 column: probability of impacting the target zone if failure occurs (unit: TRAQ enum).

likelihood_of_failure_and_impact.description: ISA TRAQ Matrix 1 combined output cell (unit: TRAQ enum).

consequences_of_failure.description: ISA TRAQ Matrix 2 column: severity of harm or damage upon impact (unit: TRAQ enum).

overall_risk_rating.description: ISA TRAQ Matrix 2 final risk rating (unit: TRAQ enum).

residual_risk_rating.description: Projected risk rating following prescribed regenerative or structural intervention (unit: TRAQ enum).

municipal_permit_disposition.description: Statutory compliance mapping aligned with schemas/municipal-ordinance.schema.json.

jurisdiction_id.description: Municipality identifier matching data/ordinances/ records or 'unincorporated' (unit: slug string).

ordinance_citation.description: Statutory chapter and section governing the tree (e.g., 'Austin LDC 25-8', 'Ashland AMC 18.4.5', 'Medford Tree Protection Guidelines 2026') (unit: legal citation string).

protection_tier.description: Ordinance classification evaluated from DBH and species (unit: enum string).

permit_required.description: True if a municipal tree preservation, encroachment, or removal permit is required (unit: boolean).

recommended_disposition.description: Conflict-free RCA disposition prioritizing biological asset preservation over removal (unit: enum string).

seasonal_oak_wilt_restriction_active.description: True if the tree is in genus Quercus and falls within prohibited Ceratocystis fagacearum vector months (unit: boolean).

codit_wall_response_rating.description: Shigo CODIT (Compartmentalization of Decay in Trees) diagnostic response evaluation across Walls 1 to 4 (unit: rating string).

sound_shell_thickness_ratio_t_over_r.description: Mattheck sound wood shell thickness to trunk radius ratio (t/R). Values >= 0.30 indicate full hollow-cylinder bending strength against windthrow (unit: dimensionless ratio 0.0 to 1.0).

sonic_tomography_or_resistograph_uri.description: URI or relative path to PiCUS sonic tomogram, IML resistograph trace, or acoustic scan image documenting internal decay (unit: URI string).

dual_valuation.description: Post-ISA/ASCA dual appraisal contrasting classical CTLA 10th Edition depreciated cost against Regenerative Holobiont Biological Equity.

ctla_10th_ed_depreciated_usd.description: Classical CTLA 10th Edition Trunk Formula depreciated valuation (unit: US dollars).

holobiont_200yr_biological_equity_usd.description: Regenerative Holobiont Living Asset Equity valuing biomass carbon, vadose zone hydrology, and mycorrhizal network value with habitat multiplier (unit: US dollars).

veteran_keystone_habitat_multiplier.description: Ecological keystone and saproxylic habitat value multiplier (1.0 = standard, 1.5-3.5 = veteran hollow keystone tree) (unit: scalar multiplier).

valuation_delta_usd.description: Difference between holobiont living asset equity and CTLA depreciated value (unit: US dollars).

rhizosphere_and_root_collar.description: Domain 2: Subterranean root-collar architecture, stem-girdling root forensics, pneumatic AirSpade geometry, and root zone radii.

root_flare_burial_depth_cm.description: Depth of soil, fill, or excess mulch burying the primary structural root flare below grade; 0 indicates flare visible at grade (unit: centimeters).

root_flare_diameter_cm.description: Basal trunk diameter at the root flare (DRF) used in the AS 4970 / Mattheck SRZ equation (unit: centimeters).

stem_girdling_root_count.description: Number of distinct stem-girdling or primary buttress-compressing roots identified during root collar inspection (unit: integer count).

stem_girdling_root_severity.description: Proportion of trunk circumference compressed by stem-girdling roots (unit: severity enum).

airspade_radial_trenching_geometry.description: Supersonic pneumatic excavation (AirSpade) diagnostic and decompaction geometry.

execution_status.description: Whether pneumatic excavation was executed during diagnosis, prescribed, or both (unit: enum string).

operating_pressure_psi.description: Supersonic nozzle air pressure calibrated to avoid periderm stripping on fine roots (unit: pounds per square inch).

trench_count.description: Number of radial decompaction spokes extending from the outer root collar toward the dripline (unit: integer count).

trench_length_m.description: Mean radial length of each pneumatic trench (unit: meters).

trench_width_cm.description: Mean width of each pneumatic trench (unit: centimeters).

trench_depth_cm.description: Mean excavation depth breaking through the anaerobic compaction pan (unit: centimeters).

root_collar_excavation_radius_m.description: Radius of the circular root-collar decompaction basin around the trunk base (unit: meters).

crz_radius_m.description: Critical Root Zone radius computed per municipal or ANSI A300 standard (unit: meters).

srz_radius_m.description: Structural Root Zone radius computed via AS 4970 / Mattheck windthrow equation (unit: meters).

tiz_radius_m.description: Tree Influence Zone radius encompassing the canopy dripline, lateral feeder roots, mycorrhizal network, and micro-hydrologic catchment (unit: meters).

soil_and_microbiome_baseline.description: Domain 3: Quantitative physical, chemical, and biological rhizosphere metrics.

bulk_density_g_cm3.description: Dry soil bulk density in the top 0 to 15 cm feeder-root horizon (unit: grams per cubic centimeter).

penetrometer_resistance_psi.description: Soil compaction resistance to root penetration at 15 cm depth; root-limiting threshold typically near 300 psi (unit: pounds per square inch).

infiltration_rate_mm_hr.description: Steady-state water infiltration rate measured via ring infiltrometer inside the TIZ (unit: millimeters per hour).

organic_matter_pct.description: Soil organic matter concentration by dry weight (unit: percent).

soil_ph.description: Rhizosphere soil pH in 1:1 or 1:2 water suspension (unit: pH units).

lab_panel_url.description: URI pointing to the primary laboratory analysis report (e.g., TAMU / A&L Labs) (unit: URI).

lab_sample_id.description: Unique chain-of-custody sample identifier assigned by the testing laboratory (unit: string identifier).

mycorrhizal_and_fungal_observations.description: Field and laboratory indicators of rhizosphere fungal and mycorrhizal symbiosis.

dominant_mycorrhizal_guild.description: Primary mycorrhizal association guild of the host tree species (unit: enum string).

fungal_to_bacterial_biomass_ratio.description: Ratio of total fungal biomass to bacterial biomass (F:B); null if biological assay is not yet returned (unit: dimensionless mass ratio).

hyphal_colonization_status.description: Visual and root-tip inspection rating of saprotrophic and mycorrhizal hyphae during AirSpade exposure (unit: enum string).

observed_fruiting_bodies_or_rhizomorphs.description: Macrofungi sporocarps, ectomycorrhizal root tips, or rhizomorphs observed within the TIZ.

species_or_morphotype.description: Scientific name or field morphotype of the observed fungus (unit: taxon string).

inaturalist_taxon_id.description: iNaturalist taxon ID for the fungal observation, or null if identified only to morphotype (unit: integer ID).

ecological_role.description: Functional guild distinguishing beneficial mycorrhizal/saprotrophic fungi from structural decay pathogens (unit: enum string).

understory_and_guild_prescription.description: Domain 4: Bioregional organic soil amendments, arborist woodchip mulch horizon, and native companion plant guild keyed to iNaturalist and open-nursery.

reference_ecosystem_name.description: Target local native forest/savanna reference ecosystem per SER Principle 3 (e.g., 'Rogue Valley Oregon White Oak Savanna', 'Edwards Plateau Live Oak-Ashe Juniper Woodland') (unit: ecosystem name string).

biochar_volume_liters.description: Volume of biologically pre-charged high-carbon biochar incorporated into radial trenches (unit: liters).

humate_mass_kg.description: Dry mass of humic and fulvic acid amendment prescribed for cation exchange restoration (unit: kilograms).

compost_volume_cubic_m.description: Volume of fungal-dominant thermophilic or vermicompost topdressed or backfilled into radial trenches (unit: cubic meters).

compost_extract_volume_liters.description: Volume of aerated or biologically extracted liquid soil drench applied to the TIZ (unit: liters).

mulch_depth_cm.description: Prescribed depth of coarse, un-dyed arborist ramial woodchip mulch across the TIZ, pulled back 15 cm from the root flare (unit: centimeters).

mulch_coverage_area_m2.description: Total surface area converted from compacted turfgrass or bare pan to woodchip forest floor (unit: square meters).

synthetic_npk_and_fungicide_exclusion_ve.description: Confirms that the prescription excludes high-salt synthetic NPK fertilizers and persistent systemic soil fungicides that suppress mycorrhizal networks (unit: boolean).

native_companion_species_guild.description: Multi-layer native understory and companion guild species prescribed within the TIZ.

scientific_name.description: Binomial scientific name of the native companion plant (unit: Latin binomial string).

common_name.description: Regional common name of the companion plant (unit: string).

inaturalist_taxon_id.description: Verified iNaturalist taxon identifier linking the planted guild member to biodiversity monitoring (unit: integer ID).

open_nursery_batch_id.description: Seed-source and propagation batch identifier linking to Open Nursery provenance records (unit: batch ID string).

stratum_layer.description: Vertical forest architecture stratum occupied by the guild species (unit: enum string).

functional_role.description: Primary ecological function contributed to the host tree holobiont (unit: enum string).

quantity_planted.description: Number of individual plants or plugs prescribed for this guild taxon (unit: integer count).

outcome_monitoring_schedule.description: Domain 5: Longitudinal verification schedule combining 1-year leading process/vigor indicators and 5-year lagging ecological outcome targets per Newton et al. (2020), Gann et al. (2019), and the STIM Protocol.

stim_hypothesis_statement.description: Explicit causal hypothesis linking the diagnosed rhizosphere stressor and prescribed nodal intervention to measurable physiological recovery (unit: narrative string).

stim_kill_criterion.description: Empirical threshold at which the prescribed hypothesis is falsified and requires diagnostic revision (unit: narrative string).

one_year_leading_indicators.description: 12-month leading indicator checklist verifying immediate physiological response and habitat establishment.

scheduled_reinspection_date.description: Committed ISO 8601 date for the 1-year leading indicator audit (unit: YYYY-MM-DD date).

target_canopy_dieback_max_pct.description: Maximum acceptable upper-crown branch dieback at 12 months post-intervention (unit: percent).

target_annual_twig_extension_min_cm.description: Minimum terminal shoot extension indicating restored hydraulic conductivity and vigor (unit: centimeters).

target_woundwood_callus_closure_mm_yr.description: Minimum annual radial woundwood development on pruning or SGR excision cuts (unit: millimeters per year).

root_flare_unburied_verified.description: Checklist requirement confirming primary root flare remains exposed above mulch and soil grade (unit: boolean).

mulch_horizon_and_litter_incorporation_i.description: Checklist requirement confirming active saprotrophic breakdown at the soil-mulch interface without anaerobic souring (unit: boolean).

soil_surface_crusting_or_capping_absent.description: Checklist requirement confirming absence of hydrophobic surface sealing or bare soil crusting (unit: boolean).

companion_guild_survival_min_pct.description: Minimum required survival percentage across planted native_companion_species_guild individuals at Year 1 (unit: percent).

fixed_photopoint_azimuth_deg.description: Compass bearing from fixed reference point to tree stem for repeatable longitudinal canopy photography (unit: degrees).

five_year_lagging_indicators.description: 60-month lagging outcome targets verifying soil architecture, carbon sequestration, hydrologic infiltration, and Sanctuary Scorecard rollup.

scheduled_audit_date.description: Committed ISO 8601 date for the 5-year lagging outcome verification audit (unit: YYYY-MM-DD date).

target_bulk_density_max_g_cm3.description: Target 5-year ceiling for rhizosphere dry bulk density demonstrating sustained decompaction (unit: grams per cubic centimeter).

target_infiltration_rate_min_mm_hr.description: Target 5-year floor for steady-state water infiltration rate inside the TIZ (unit: millimeters per hour).

target_organic_matter_min_pct.description: Target 5-year minimum soil organic matter percentage in the top 15 cm horizon (unit: percent).

target_fungal_to_bacterial_ratio_min.description: Target 5-year minimum fungal-to-bacterial biomass ratio appropriate for woodland/forest succession (unit: dimensionless mass ratio).

target_ser_recovery_wheel_stars.description: Target 5-year composite rating on the SER Five-Star Ecological Recovery Wheel across physical conditions, species composition, structural diversity, and ecosystem function (unit: 1.0 to 5.0 star scale).

sanctuary_scorecard_targets.description: First-class rollup contract bridging tree-level Regenerative Diagnostic assessments (planned modules/arbor/) into the property-level Sanctuary Scorecard (planned modules/sanctuary/) across all five Scorecard dimensions.

tiz_footprint_area_m2.description: Tree Influence Zone surface area (pi * tiz_radius_m^2) used as the spatial weighting denominator when aggregating Soil Health Index and Water Dynamics across a property stand (unit: square meters).

canopy_projection_area_m2.description: Elliptical vertical crown projection area (pi * (crown_spread_ns_m / 2) * (crown_spread_ew_m / 2)) used to aggregate Canopy Coverage across the property parcel (unit: square meters).

soil_health_index_baseline_score.description: Baseline composite Soil Health Index score (0 to 100) derived from Domain 2 root-collar burial and Domain 3 bulk_density_g_cm3, infiltration_rate_mm_hr, organic_matter_pct, and fungal_to_bacterial_biomass_ratio (unit: index points).

soil_health_index_target_score.description: Target 5-year composite Soil Health Index score on a 0 to 100 scale (unit: index points).

canopy_volume_expansion_target_pct.description: Projected net change in three-dimensional photosynthetic crown volume over 5 years derived from Domain 1 height_m, crown_spread_ns_m, crown_spread_ew_m, and live_crown_ratio_pct (unit: percent).

stormwater_interception_baseline_liters_.description: Baseline annual canopy rainfall interception (Xiao et al. 2000) plus TIZ infiltration storage prior to decompaction (unit: liters per year).

stormwater_interception_target_liters_yr.description: Target 5-year combined canopy rainfall interception and TIZ soil pore storage per year after Domain 2 AirSpade trenching and Domain 4 mulch/biochar installation (unit: liters per year).

documented_native_biodiversity_taxa_base.description: Baseline count of verified native plant and fungal taxa (keyed to inaturalist_taxon_id in Domains 3 and 4) within the TIZ at assessment date (unit: integer taxon count).

documented_native_biodiversity_taxa_min.description: Minimum target count of verified native species (plants, fungi, insects, birds) logged via iNaturalist within the TIZ by Year 5 (unit: integer taxon count).

restoration_potential_baseline_pct.description: Baseline percentage of SER reference ecosystem potential currently expressed by this tree holobiont (unit: percent).

restoration_potential_realized_pct.description: Target percentage of site-specific ecological potential achieved at the 5-year audit (unit: percent).
